transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, this is an AI assistant calling from your care team. May I ask if I am speaking with Rahul?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Rahul, I have your health results here. Your fasting blood glucose reading from October first, two thousand twenty-six was one hundred eighty milligrams per deciliter. transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I would like to see a doctor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Before we book the consultation, I want to share one more result with you. Your HbA1c reading from October first, two thousand twenty-six was eight point two percent. This reflects your average blood sugar over roughly the past three months, and it is above the common reference range which is below five point seven percent.

A doctor can review these results with you in detail. Would you like to book a consultation now? If you have a preference, please let me know the part of the day that works best for you.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Any time is fine. The first time you have available works for me.

transcript.text: The earliest available consultation with a doctor is Monday, October twelfth at nine thirty in the morning. Does that work for you?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, Monday, October twelfth at nine thirty in the morning works for me.
